reference_observations.vintage: exact local collected_supplement_v2 files, no refresh
reference_observations.annualization: mean of all 12 monthly or 4 quarterly SAAR observations; ratios of annual flows
reference_observations.units: fractions; report errors as percentage points

non_comparability_frozen.GDP: model produced output with unsold goods is not certified as BEA expenditure GDP
non_comparability_frozen.inflation: one-good transaction price is not a validated PCE consumption basket
non_comparability_frozen.capital: nonresidential reference scope does not certify the model wealth-financing mapping
non_comparability_frozen.CEX_PSID_SCF: micro acceptance and asset-to-bank mapping excluded from this macro stability contract

foundation_policy.primary: unchanged upstream defaults; alpha=.36, delta=.06, initial_KY=null (wealth-minus-debt initialization)
foundation_policy.secondary_status: unchanged opened-development proxy, not measured physical depreciation or approved prior
foundation_policy.capital_stock_timing: 2022 year-end is a reference opening stock for 2023, not opening stock for 2022
foundation_policy.secondary_delta_definition: 2022 nominal depreciation / 2022 current-cost year-end net capital; proxy only
foundation_policy.GDP_initialization: retain upstream 2022 reference 25474.6 billion USD; do not replace with revised GDP
foundation_policy.alpha: .36 remains a structural reference, not an estimate from labor-share data
foundation_policy.policy_path: unchanged real_society tax/rate rules, not a replay of realized 2023-2025 policies

optimization.basis: previous local screen at N256, horizon8, no extension to untested domains

simulation_calendar: synthetic t1..t8, t1 excluded from scoring; no assignment to real forecast years
